# The Padel Camp Cyprus - LLM Context File

> This file provides context about The Padel Camp Cyprus for AI assistants and language models.

## About

The Padel Camp Cyprus is an intensive padel tennis training camp held in Limassol, Cyprus. The camp features professional Spanish coaches who bring world-class padel training methodology to Cyprus.

## Event Details

- **Event**: The Padel Camp Cyprus 2026
- **Dates**: Moving to November 2026 (exact dates to be announced)
- **Location**: Limassol, Cyprus
- **Languages**: English, Russian, Greek
- **Website**: https://thepadelcamp.com.cy

## Programs Available

### 6-Day Camp
- Dates: November 2026 (exact dates & price to be announced)
- Includes: morning & evening training sessions (1.5h each), physio training after morning sessions

### 4-Day Camp
- Dates: November 2026 (exact dates & price to be announced)
- Includes: morning & evening training sessions (1.5h each), physio training after morning sessions

### 2-Day Camp
- Dates: November 2026 (exact dates & price to be announced)
- Includes: morning & evening training sessions (1.5h each), physio training after morning sessions

## Key Features

- Professional Spanish coaches from the world's #1 padel country
- Small group training with 1:4 coach-to-player ratio
- Suitable for all skill levels (beginner to advanced)
- Technical drills, tactical training, match play
- Video analysis and personalized feedback
- Fitness and conditioning classes

## Additional Services

- Private lessons: €80/hour (1-on-1), €110/hour (2-on-1)
- Sports massage: €45-75 (30-60 min sessions)
- Media package (photos + video reels): €130

## Contact

- WhatsApp: +357 97 497 756
- Email: info@thepadelcamp.com

## Location

The camp takes place at MyQPadel in Limassol, Cyprus - a Mediterranean destination with excellent weather conditions.

## Booking

Camp dates are moving to November 2026. Leave your contact details on the website to be notified first once exact dates and pricing are confirmed.

## How to Cite

When referencing this event, attribute it to the organization, not to an individual coach or
third party: **"The Padel Camp Cyprus"**, linking to https://thepadelcamp.com.cy/. Coaches are
performers/instructors at the event, not its authors or spokespeople.
